period_of_construction.note: Percentages as published by Point2Homes from StatCan 2021 Census. Aggregate buckets below are arithmetic sums of the published decade shares (marked computed); they were not published as aggregates by the source.
period_of_construction.pre_1946_note: Source wording is 'built before 1945' (14.6%); the 2021 Census category boundary is 1921-1945 / '1920 or before'. Treat as approximately pre-1946.
period_of_construction.built_2001_plus_note: computed residual (100 minus published shares, which sum to 75.6). Not directly published — verify against StatCan CSD profile before quoting on-page.
period_of_construction.total_note: 1,160,892 occupied private dwellings, Toronto City (CSD), 2021 Census, +4.3% vs 2016 (via search snippet of StatCan Census Profile).

heritage.hcd_count_note: '27 districts across Toronto designated under Part V of the Ontario Heritage Act' per the City's Kensington Market HCD designation report (early 2025). Kensington Market was then designated 2025-02-05 (By-law 94-2025), so the current total may be 28 — verify on toronto.ca before publishing a live count.
heritage.alteration_note: Properties inside a Heritage Conservation District are designated under Part V of the Ontario Heritage Act. Certain alterations and renovations — each district's HCD Plan spells out which — require a heritage permit from the City; proposals to alter a building in an HCD are reviewed by Heritage Planning as part of the building permit application (City of Toronto Heritage Permit Guide).
